units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a regional power located in East Asia. Though it isn't one of the seven majors, it generally ends up as a ⟦1⟧ due to it leading the Chinese United Front. It borders the warlord states of ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ to the north, the ⟦5⟧ and the ⟦6⟧ to the west, ⟦7⟧ to the south west and the ⟦8⟧ and ⟦9⟧ to the south. China may also border the ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ and ⟦12⟧ due to their colonial holdings after reclaiming its core territories.

Due to China being fragmented by the warlord era, much of its core territory is owned by warlord cliques with the ⟦0⟧ Clique, the ⟦1⟧ and the ⟦2⟧ in the south, the ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ Cliques to the far north west, the ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ Cliques to the north west, the ⟦8⟧ and the ⟦9⟧ to the west and the ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧ and ⟦12⟧ Clique to the north. Nearby, there is ⟦13⟧ in the north and both nations engage in events revolving around the ongoing Chinese Civil War.

The nation is fractured from civil wars and political strife, making it seemingly weak and easy prey for the Japanese, who not only have both naval and air superiority, but also tanks. However, with the highest base population – ⟦0⟧ – (which will increase to an even higher level once China is united) and a great deal of room to grow to an industrial giant, China can buy time and put it to good use. If they can overcome their fractiousness and stand together, China can turn Japan's attack into a dangerous meat grinder to sap Japan's manpower and turn themselves into a power on par with the other world majors.

The history of the Republic of China begins after the Xinhai Revolution against the Qing dynasty in 1911, when the formation of a constitutional republic put an end to 2,000 years of rule by various, occasionally competitive, imperial dynasties. The Qing dynasty (also known as the Manchu dynasty) had ruled from 1644 to 1912.

The republic experienced many trials and tribulations after its founding and is fractured by both internal and external elements. The central government was unable to assert full control over the country, resulting in the frontier regions of Uriankhai ( ⟦0⟧), ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ breaking away and becoming ⟦3⟧ independent, and the provinces controlled by often disobedient warlord generals. Worse still, the Western powers and Japan continued to maintain their "spheres of influence" carved out during the Qing dynasty to force trade and exploitation.

In 1928, the republic was nominally unified by Chiang Kai-Shek under the "Kuomintang" (KMT) – also known as Chinese Nationalist Party – after the Northern Expedition, and embarked on a program of industrialization and modernization. However, the republic remained rife with conflicts as the Nationalist government struggled to keep the warlords in check (represented in-game by the presence of autonomous warlord cliques, prominently of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, the Muslim Ma Cliques and ⟦3⟧), while fighting a civil war with the nascent ⟦4⟧.

On September 18, 1931, the Kwantung Army of ⟦0⟧ staged a false flag operation as a pretext to invade northeastern China in what became known as the Mukden Incident, leading to the swift occupation of northeastern China and the subsequent creation of the puppet state of ⟦1⟧ in 1932. A period of relative peace ensued for the next few years, until it was broken by ⟦2⟧ with a full-scale invasion in 1937 after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident. The Nationalists and Communists set aside hostilities and formed the Second United Front against Japan. ⟦3⟧ lasted until 1945 with the unconditional surrender of ⟦4⟧, following the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and the Soviet invasion of ⟦5⟧. The Chinese Civil War, however, would reignite almost immediately thereafter, with major hostilities lasting from 1946 until 1950, after Communist forces had taken control of mainland China and the Republic of China had retreated to Taiwan. To this day, although combat has ceased, a peace treaty has never been signed, and the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China both claim to be the only legitimate government of all China.
Main article: Chinese national focus tree

⟦0⟧ got a unique national focus tree as part of the Waking the Tiger expansion. Ever since the DLC's integration, it is now available in the base game. It also received its own unique expansion of their national focus tree in the ⟦1⟧ Expansion Pack DLC.
China's unique focus tree has 7 branches, 11 sub-branches within them and 1 hidden focus:
The ⟦0⟧ branch follows Sun Yat-sen's ⟦1⟧ and sets China's path towards Democracy. These focuses will decide which president the player can choose.

Unify as the China Democratic League Sub-branch Afterwards, China will then be able to elect a president. If Revive the Chinese Action Committee is completed, Zhang Lan may be president if the Chinese Soviet Republic is not Democratic and has not completed Seek a Peaceful Reunification. Otherwise, Chen Mingshu can be president. Carsun Chang can be president if Invite Carsun Chang is completed. Soong Ching Ling can be president if Give Protection of Civil Rights is completed. Zeng Qi can be president if Ally the Young China Party is completed.
Unify as the China Democratic League Sub-branch

Afterwards, China will then be able to elect a president. If ⟦0⟧ is completed, ⟦1⟧ may be president if the ⟦2⟧ is not ⟦3⟧ and has not completed ⟦4⟧. Otherwise, ⟦5⟧ can be president. ⟦6⟧ can be president if ⟦7⟧ is completed. ⟦8⟧ can be president if ⟦9⟧ is completed. ⟦10⟧ can be president if ⟦11⟧ is completed.

Then the branch divides into three paths. The leftmost path requests support from foreign nations. The rightmost path follows Sun Yat-sen's principles of Nationalism, Democracy and Welfare, then builds ⟦0⟧ in the warlords in order to annex them, then expands China into the neighboring countries. The middle path allies with the ⟦1⟧ or makes ⟦2⟧ faction and spreads democracy throughout Asia and Oceania.
Avoid Another Crisis Sub-branch The shared focuses between the and the Wang Jingwei paths delay the Japanese invasion, declare war against Japan and request aid from Germany
The shared focuses between the and the Wang Jingwei paths delay the ⟦0⟧ invasion, declare war against ⟦1⟧ and request aid from ⟦2⟧
The Kuomintang branch sets the country to placing either Wang Jingwei or Chiang Kai-Shek into power.

Prepare for a Change in Leadership Sub-branch This branch sets Wang Jingwei as the leader of the Kuomintang. It will then infiltrate the five branches of government in favor of the new leadership. Then once the Chinese Soviet Republic is removed, China will then create a faction with other Asian nations and declare war against the colonial nations in order to liberate and puppet the Asian colonies.

Then once the ⟦1⟧ is removed, China will then create a faction with other Asian nations and declare war against the colonial nations in order to liberate and puppet the Asian colonies.

Reinforce connection with Shanghai Elites/Decree the End to Corruption/Open Schools for the Destitute Sub-branch These shared branches between Wang Jingwei and Chiang Kai-Shek request aid from the Shanghai Elites, deal with corruption in the country and give women military roles.

The historical branch keeps ⟦0⟧ in power. It would then create a faction with the warlords and build up the military. It will then pressure the allied warlords to become subjects then annexation. Then once the ⟦1⟧ is removed, China may then join the ⟦2⟧ faction and go to war with the ⟦3⟧ or declare war on ⟦4⟧ and the ⟦5⟧ while getting cores.

This section of the Chiang-Kai Shek branch gives ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in a war against ⟦2⟧.

The shared Chiang Kai-Shek and Blue Shirt section of the tree focuses on uniting the country with reeducating the masses with the New Life Movement, an intelligence agency and countering corruption within China.
